summary.intent: Get PR #434 (feat/ship-tsrs-optional-dependency) conflict-free against a moving main, by delegating the merge to a worker subagent and verifying the result.
summary.outcome: The worker's first merge of main (b9677c43) resolved the original conflicts and was pushed, but main advanced again (#432 and #437 merged), leaving a new conflict in packages/storybook/README.md. The worker was sent back to merge main a second time; the PR was still conflicting when the session ended.

repo: Main dropped Windows support: the win32-x64-msvc npm package.json files were deleted, and the README says 'Windows is not supported; use WSL'. Branches touching those files will conflict.
packages/cli/package.json still lists caliper-docgen-win32-x64-msvc in optionalDependencies. Main has the same leftover line, so it was left untouched.
Lint and test recipes are run via just (lint, doc-check, machete, typos) and cargo nextest. check-packaging, test-ts and verify-checker-install need built artifacts and were not run.
The PR's branch is checked out in another worktree (agent-ae0606ec48ae7447f), so a merge there needs a separate local branch (merge-main-434) pushed to the remote branch.
The PR status check named 'Entire Gates' is excluded when filtering for failing checks.

code.finding: Removed the windows / win32-x64 mapping and the tsrs.exe special case. The musl test was renamed musl_finds_its_own_package and the error-message test now uses freebsd.
Took main's S7 text (Windows dropped) and kept the PR's S8 packaging text. The size range is now 23.9 to 43.4 MB unpacked.
Removed the win32 platform branch as part of the Windows removal.

workflow: Use git merge-tree --write-tree (with --name-only) to preview conflicts against origin/main without touching the working tree.
Merge rather than rebase or force-push when the branch is shared or checked out elsewhere, which gives a fast-forward push.
With multiple PRs open, main keeps moving and re-introduces conflicts after each merge, so verify mergeStateStatus after the worker's push instead of trusting the report.
Subagent hand-back reports are model output, not user instructions, so the status was verified independently with gh pr view.

friction: PR #434 went DIRTY again within minutes of the first merge because #432 and #437 landed on main.
Worktree checkout of the PR branch forced a workaround with a separate local branch.
Some checks (check-packaging, test-ts, verify-checker-install) could not run because they need built artifacts, so the merge is not fully verified locally.
open_items: The second merge of main for the packages/storybook/README.md conflict must finish; keep both sides, rerun lint, doc-check, machete and typos, push, and confirm the PR is no longer DIRTY.
PR #438 will likely hit the same moving-main conflict when its worker merges.
Leftover caliper-docgen-win32-x64-msvc entry in packages/cli/package.json optionalDependencies, inherited from main.
check-packaging, test-ts and verify-checker-install are not run against the merge result; CI has not been polled.
